name: kubescape
description: Scan Kubernetes clusters, manifests, and Helm charts for misconfigurations and image vulnerabilities; fix findings; query posture through the Kubescape MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Kubernetes security scanning, fixes, and MCP tools
interface.longDescription: Teach agents to run the Kubescape CLI accurately: scan live clusters, YAML/JSON manifests, Helm charts, and container images against frameworks such as NSA, MITRE, and CIS; choose output formats; remediate findings with kubescape fix; and use the bundled kubescape mcpserver MCP integration when cluster operator data is available.
defaultPrompt: Scan this cluster with the NSA framework and summarize failed controls
Scan ./manifests to JSON, then fix safe findings in place
Start kubescape mcpserver and list high-severity vulnerabilities
